args.body: generation 1: Generation 0 refused "wing" and named what it does allow here: the styliform cartilage and the styliform element, the wrist strut that tensions a gliding membrane. So name the mammalian glider outright -- a patagium AND a styliform cartilage -- and see which half the ontology will give. Then declare the three quantities the aerodynamics needs, each with a source saying it is a design input and not a measurement.
